changes: Classic font search stages a keyboard candidate independently of the current font. Up/Down and Page Up/Down browse virtualized results and reveal the candidate; Enter applies and closes, Escape cancels. Search retains ordinary editing keys. A candidate outline and search accessibility description identify the pending choice. Navigation keys are suppressed during IME preedit/commit handling so TextEdit receives composition events without accepting a font or moving its composition cursor.

gui.scope: Full GUI suite. Added desktop 1x/compact 2x repeated-layout tests cover a 1000-family fixture catalog, arrow/page navigation, candidate visibility/description, staged acceptance/cancellation, empty-result Enter and synthetic IME preedit/commit routing. An actual App test accepts Selawik through Enter, persists the font preference and preserves unpublished canvas text plus document/history semantics. Extended View menu alignment coverage, committed separately, includes Canvas size at desktop width.

gpu.scope: 16 component-level light/dark desktop/compact GPU captures use installed Selawik UI fonts and a deterministic 1000-name fixture catalog. Family/size lists, pending keyboard candidates and accepted toolbar labels are shown. This exporter does not render a complete App scene or establish fixture fonts as installed document fonts.

checks: Strict workspace all-target Clippy, formatting, source-length and whitespace checks passed.
limits: Synthetic IME events and AccessKit description checks do not qualify native OS IME or screen-reader behavior. Full native Windows/historical fidelity, additional text interaction features and broader T15 acceptance remain incomplete. No text rasterizer or performance change.
